title: Felix and the Language
author: X. M. Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Thackeray, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
